title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: When you average predictions from multiple models, how does it affect the bias and variance of the ensemble model compared to a single model?

title: Effect on Bias
text: Averaging predictions from multiple models tends to reduce the bias of the ensemble model. This is because the ensemble model can capture more patterns from the data by combining different perspectives.

title: Effect on Variance
text: Averaging predictions from multiple models generally reduces the variance of the ensemble model. This is because the errors from individual models tend to cancel each other out, leading to more stable predictions.

title: Analyzing Bias and Variance
text: Consider the effects of averaging predictions from multiple models on bias and variance. Does it increase, decrease, or have no effect on each?
